name: SEKA ExAero / ExAero RDC
why_interesting: A new purpose-built aero road platform with an 820 g RDC frame claim, a 935 g standard frame, unusually broad cockpit sizing and a documented 6.67 kg owner build.
missing: Exact mainland package and price mapping for standard versus RDC
Current mainland checkout, delivery and warranty handling for each trim

facts.frame: T1100/M46J-claimed carbon with one-piece molding, fully internal routing and UDH
facts.frame_weight_basis: RDC, size 54, unpainted, excluding paint and metal hardware, ±35 g; standard frame is 935 g on the same basis
facts.sizes: 44, 49, 52, 54, 56, 58 and 61; official chainstays are 408 mm across the range
facts.drivetrain: Shimano Di2 and SRAM AXS routing documented; removable front-derailleur mount
facts.cockpit: Gladius standard or ALTA +25 mm, each offered in 19 combinations; MAG aero bottles are sold separately

observed_price.price_basis: Public exact-model launch post headline, starting frameset price; trim and included-package mapping unresolved

price_status: Public starting price; do not assume it is the 820 g RDC package.
source_note: This is the 32 mm road ExAero generation, not the published 56/52 mm ExAero GR gravel platform. The official product page supports 820 g RDC and 935 g standard size-54 frame claims, 32 mm measured maximum tire capacity, BSA 68, UDH, seven race-oriented sizes and manufacturer wind-tunnel/CFD claims. A public RDC owner documented a 6.67 kg custom build with a 2× drivetrain and 60 mm wheels; that is useful build evidence, not a normalized factory-bike weight.
